top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 physiology award to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov is a mature, transformative achievement: the discovery of GLP-1 and its active form directly enabled incretin-based therapies now proven in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-laureate allocation fits the discovery-level scope of the citation and respects the three-person limit, and no award is clearly inferior to recognizing work of this impact.
